Move your phone slowly to find the floor, then aim the circle at a corner and tap Add point.
Aim at the next corner along the wall and tap Add point to measure the length.

Length %1$s · Width %2$s · Height %3$s. Tap Send to calculator, or slide again to adjust.

Calcupine Measure needs the camera to measure.
Stand with your back against a wall and hold the phone at the height below. Aim the cross at the line where the opposite wall meets the floor, then tap Capture.
Length %1$s. Now stand with your back against a side wall and aim at the bottom of the wall opposite you. Tap Capture.
Length %1$s · Width %2$s. Without moving, tilt up and aim at the top of that same wall, where it meets the ceiling. Tap Capture.
